sheets.prompt: Object design reference sheet for a science fiction exploration game: one floating crystal cluster worth five of the game's currency, drawn four times side by side at the same scale on a plain cream background: front view, side view, three-quarter view, and beside it a single small crystal for comparison. The cluster is one larger paler shard, 38 centimetres, translucent pale cyan almost white, broad weathered flat facets and a lavender seam, with two small shards grown at its foot at angles, a stronger soft light glowing inside it. It floats upright, slightly tilted, at knee height above the ground, turning slowly, with a small soft round shadow on the ground beneath and clear air between. A small cloaked human traveller with a round jade fluid backpack stands beside it for scale. Moebius science-fiction, Franco-Belgian ligne claire, exquisite fine pen contours, sparse delicate hatching only in shadows, luminous flat pastel gouache colours, pale cyan, white and lavender glass, restrained cream paper grain, clear readable construction, no lettering. Avoid: photorealism, 3d render, text, watermark, lettering, labels, gem, jewellery, rupee, coin.
sheets.why: great but only the small one
